sents.zh: 很久以前，人们用的钱是金子做的。
sents.en: Long ago, the money people used was made of gold.
That kind of money was heavy.

sents.zh: 买很多东西的时候，钱也很多。
sents.en: When you bought a lot, you needed a lot of it.

sents.zh: 商人走路的时候，拿不动。
sents.en: Merchants could not carry it as they travelled.

sents.zh: 宋朝的人想到了一个办法。
sents.en: Song people thought of a way.
They made money out of paper.
Paper is light and can be carried on you.

sents.zh: 商人可以走很远去做买卖了。
sents.en: Merchants could travel far to trade.
There was more and more trade in the cities.

sents.zh: 今天，世界上很多国家还用纸做的钱。
sents.en: Today, many countries still use money made of paper.
